description.en:
Sets a Special Move name placeholder for the next messages. Placeholders are filled in the text of the next messages: the value is stored under a key made from the kind and the index, which the message parser reads when it meets the matching tag in the text.
The key is REP_SKILL_<index>; the move can be given by ID string (stored as its hash) or by number.
Placeholder number used in the message text (0, 1, 2...).
Special Move ID string, e.g. "whs0003", or number.

Always null.
null if the script system is not ready or too few arguments are given.
